who.label: Who I work with
who.heading: Built for people with a lot going on.
who.intro: I work best with busy adults who want to get stronger, fitter and more capable, but need training to fit around work, travel, family and everything else life throws at them.

items.title: You’ve been inconsistent for too long
items.body: You know training matters, but work, travel and life keep knocking it off course. You want a plan you can actually keep going with when life gets busy.

items.title: Your body keeps getting in the way
items.body: A niggle, old injury or lack of confidence keeps interrupting your training. We work around what’s there, build you back up and keep moving forward.

items.title: You want to understand what you’re doing
items.body: You don’t just want someone counting reps. You want to know why the plan works, how to train well and how to make good decisions for yourself over time.

approach.label: The approach
approach.heading: What I actually believe about training.

items.claim: Your body *adapts*. It isn't a machine that breaks.
items.body: Technique matters, but it’s only part of the picture. Load, volume, training history and how quickly you progress all matter too. The goal isn’t perfect movement. It’s building a body that can adapt.

items.claim: Progress is more than *the numbers going up*.
items.body: Better technique, more control, more confidence and more capacity all count as progress. Adding weight matters, but only when you can actually own what you’re doing.

items.claim: You don't have to *earn the right* to train.
items.body: You don’t need to be fitter, more mobile or pain-free before you start. We begin where you are, teach you how to train well and build your capacity from there.

items.claim: The real question is: *what do you want out of it?*
items.body: The goal isn’t to chase what looks optimal on paper. It’s to work out what you want, what your life can support, and the smartest route between the two.

items.claim: It was never really about *ripped abs*.
items.body: It’s about feeling stronger, fitter and more capable in your body, and getting more out of your life because of it.

story.label: My story
story.heading: I didn't come to this from a background in sport.
story.photoAlt: Rupert Drew coaching a client through a squat in his London Bridge gym
paragraphs: Back in the day I wanted to work in music. I partied too much, felt pretty aimless and had no real idea what I was doing with myself.
Encouraged by my big brother, I qualified as a personal trainer to help other people find the same thing. I knew almost nothing back then.

A few years later I moved to a body transformation studio in London. I learned a lot about fat loss, muscle gain and getting people results, but I also realised fitness had to be about more than getting lean.
So I kept learning. Courses, mentorships, coaching and years of working directly with people taught me how much good coaching depends on understanding the person in front of you.
How they move. What their life looks like. What keeps getting in the way. What they actually want from training.
That’s still how I coach now.
story.pullQuote: My goal is to help you understand your body, train with confidence and build something you can eventually manage without me.
story.closing: Outside of coaching, you’ll usually find me Olympic lifting or doing jiu-jitsu, still learning, still getting things wrong and gradually getting better.

quote.text: I'd always had this image of personal trainers as aggressive, shouty types who bark orders at you. He couldn't be further from that. He worked *with* me rather than at me.
quote.name: Sam L.

work.label: How it works
work.heading: Simple, progressive and built around you.

items.title: We have a chat
items.body: We work out what you want, what’s been getting in the way and what your body and schedule can handle right now.

items.title: We train
items.body: You start seeing evidence that the plan works. You move better, get stronger, build fitness and gain confidence in what your body can do.

items.title: We push
items.body: Once the foundations are solid, we expand from there. More strength, more fitness, more variety and more freedom to pursue bigger goals.

contact.label: Get in touch
contact.heading: Fancy a conversation about it?
contact.lede: Send me a message and tell me roughly where you're at. No commitment and no hard sell, just a straight conversation about whether I can help.
